description: Source code for the NumericArgument class, a Drupal plugin handling numeric arguments in views, including options for multiple values and exclusion filters.

classes.name: NumericArgument
classes.description: A Drupal plugin class for handling numeric arguments in views, supporting multiple value options and exclusion filters.

methods.name: buildOptionsForm
methods.description: Builds the options form with checkboxes for multiple values and exclusion.

methods.name: title
methods.description: Generates a title for the argument based on its value and options.

methods.name: titleQuery
methods.description: Returns the current value(s) for the title query.

methods.name: query
methods.description: Builds the database query based on the argument's value and options.

methods.name: getSortName
methods.description: Returns the sort name 'Numerical' with context.

methods.name: getContextDefinition
methods.description: Provides context definition, defaulting to integer type if not specified.
